actual_scope: What explicit uniform stock envelope does the actual selected stopped producer supply at one bootstrap stage?
bottleneck_link: The selected kappa binds through the m=73 complex producer; its uniform stock envelope is the H3 premise of the retained fit chain. Binding its per-level stock to source removes one inherited implementation obligation without changing any kappa arithmetic.
stop_rule: Stop after one producer (the selected m=73 complex stopped producer), one stage domain (native stage 1, e >= 2^4785575287428), the exact stock quantities bound by source, and the exact missing shape lemma. Do not rerun cutoff-pair arithmetic, do not import 57604 or 252 as a selected coefficient, and do not extend to the ordinary m=64 chain of predecessors.
evidence: verify.py (PASS_SELECTED_STOCK_ENVELOPE_M73, 45 checks, 5 rejected controls) binds every stock quantity the retained sources give at the m=73 complex producer: exact |Sp(72,2)| = 2^1296 prod_{j=1..36} (2^(2j)-1) with bit length 2628, per-level stock B = 2628 + 14 = 2642 against the 14,826-family split, halving 5329 > 4608, and both row ledgers 16469 and 15555 recomputed with 4370 = ceil(43*2642/26). The uniform coefficient stays blocked: the pinned complex cover note states no w-shaped per-level divisor, so the shape constants A, B, rho of the composition sigma <= (43/26)(1-s)(A+B)+rho remain unbound (selected-coarse-depth-stock/PROOF.md states the same). Conditional guard comparison only: ceil(log2(8*16469)) = 18 and ceil(log2(8*15555)) = 17 are far below the recorded stage-1 sufficient guard H1 = 6562783.
